newsitem.title: DUBAI: U.N. atomic agency's Blix in Iran for inspections.
newsitem.headline: U.N. atomic agency's Blix in Iran for inspections.

text.p: The head of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) is in Iran to inspect two research centres, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Sunday.
Director-General Hans Blix, who is heading an IAEA delegation on a tour which will also include Armenia and Georgia, arrived in Tehran on Saturday.
"Blix is to inspect the Bonab research centre in West Azerbaijan province and the under-construction Ramsar research centre in Mazandaran province," IRNA said.
The agency said Blix would meet President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani during his visit.
Washington has accused Iran of seeking to develop nuclear weapons, a charge which Tehran has repeatedly denied. Iran says its nuclear programme is strictly civilian.
The Vienna-based IAEA was set up 40 years ago under the auspices of the United Nations to monitor global nuclear energy issues.
